problem_text:
A logistics company needs to schedule 10 delivery routes through 10 distribution hubs.  

Each route consists of a sequence of hub stops represented as (Hub, Handling time) pairs, where each pair specifies the hub where the package must be processed and the time required for handling. The order of pairs indicates the mandatory sequence of hub visits for that route.

Route details:
* R1 follows the sequence: (H9, 2) → (H7, 9) → (H4, 7) → (H6, 2) → (H10, 9) → (H1, 1) → (H3, 5) → (H8, 6) → (H5, 6) → (H2, 1)
* R2 follows the sequence: (H8, 10) → (H3, 9) → (H1, 4) → (H5, 5) → (H6, 3) → (H7, 4) → (H4, 4) → (H2, 8) → (H9, 4) → (H10, 4)
* R3 follows the sequence: (H5, 4) → (H6, 10) → (H4, 10) → (H10, 4) → (H9, 7) → (H3, 3) → (H2, 8) → (H1, 5) → (H8, 10) → (H7, 2)
* R4 follows the sequence: (H2, 8) → (H5, 7) → (H4, 5) → (H1, 4) → (H7, 9) → (H3, 6) → (H6, 9) → (H10, 10) → (H9, 2) → (H8, 6)
* R5 follows the sequence: (H7, 5) → (H6, 9) → (H2, 3) → (H5, 3) → (H8, 2) → (H10, 3) → (H4, 2) → (H3, 5) → (H9, 1) → (H1, 4)
* R6 follows the sequence: (H9, 1) → (H6, 7) → (H7, 7) → (H5, 10) → (H3, 9) → (H1, 9) → (H4, 4) → (H8, 2) → (H10, 2) → (H2, 6)
* R7 follows the sequence: (H7, 6) → (H9, 2) → (H5, 1) → (H6, 6) → (H2, 6) → (H4, 8) → (H8, 3) → (H1, 9) → (H10, 5) → (H3, 1)
* R8 follows the sequence: (H2, 9) → (H8, 3) → (H3, 8) → (H7, 1) → (H4, 2) → (H9, 9) → (H10, 6) → (H1, 6) → (H5, 7) → (H6, 6)
* R9 follows the sequence: (H4, 1) → (H2, 6) → (H7, 9) → (H8, 8) → (H6, 2) → (H10, 9) → (H1, 5) → (H3, 2) → (H9, 10) → (H5, 6)
* R10 follows the sequence: (H1, 9) → (H3, 1) → (H5, 6) → (H6, 6) → (H2, 10) → (H9, 8) → (H4, 4) → (H10, 8) → (H7, 7) → (H8, 10)

Each package handling task at a hub must run continuously once it starts and cannot be interrupted, and each hub can only handle one package at a time. The objective is to determine the processing order of all handling tasks across the hubs so that the total completion time for all routes (makespan) is minimized.
